title: Halifax and Peggy’s Cove Tour
requirements: Infants and small children can ride in a pram or stroller
Suitable for all physical fitness levels
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb:
Experience the best of Nova Scotia in one unforgettable tour
Discover the vibrant city of Halifax and the world-famous Peggy's Cove on a scenic day trip. Explore iconic landmarks, beautiful gardens, the historic waterfront, and fascinating maritime history before heading along the stunning Lighthouse Route to the charming fishing village of Peggy's Cove. Admire breathtaking ocean views, visit the iconic lighthouse, enjoy local cafés and shops, and capture unforgettable photos. This tour perfectly combines history, culture, coastal beauty, and authentic Nova Scotian charm in one memorable experience.
